title: Isolate FetchContent build state between VIXEN build trees
body: I captured the original wave parent from an archived source at dc2ea882 using build/wave-reference while the merged tree was at build/wsl. Both configurations shared VIXEN_FETCHCONTENT_CACHE=/home/liory/projects/VBVS--VIXEN/.claude-worktrees/wavebump/.tmp/fetch. The subsequent queued cmake --build build/wsl --parallel 1, intended as the required no-op check, re-ran CMake and built 509 FetchContent actions. Rebuilding the merged tree stabilized the shared cache; a second build is needed to witness no-op. Keep downloaded source packages reusable, but isolate generated FetchContent build state by binary tree (or safely key it by source/configuration) so a baseline build cannot dirty another tree’s incremental/no-op witness.
